subject: CExplosion and CActiveExplosion — explosion type enumeration, data tables, and active explosion pool
overview: GTA:SA has 21 explosion types (indices 0-20 / 0x14). Each type is characterised by blast radius, damage, propagation behaviour, and associated particle/sound effects. CExplosion::AddExplosion registers a new explosion in the CActiveExplosion pool. The explosion logic resides in 0x736000-0x737500.

type_enum.description: Explosion type IDs are validated by range-check comparisons in explosion handlers. cmp edi, 0xc at 0x73603C and cmp eax, 0x14 at 0x73702C prove the type range. All 21 types (0x00-0x14) are listed. Names inferred from rdata strings and community weapon.dat cross-reference.

types.name: EXPLOSION_ROCKET_WEAK
types.description: Weaker rocket (minigun burst?) — cmp edi, 3 at 0x736014

types.name: EXPLOSION_OBJECT
types.description: Generic object explosion — cmp edi, 0xa at 0x7368B1

types.name: EXPLOSION_BARREL
types.description: Exploding barrel — cmp edi, 0xc at 0x73603C (hard check)

types.name: EXPLOSION_FLARE
types.description: Flare (non-damaging light burst) — cmp eax, 0x10 at 0x737004

types.name: EXPLOSION_GAS_CANISTER
types.description: Gas canister detonation — cmp eax, 0x10 at 0x737004 cluster

types.name: EXPLOSION_TRAIN
types.description: Train collision explosion — cmp eax, 0x13 at 0x737027

types.name: EXPLOSION_PEDGRENADE
types.description: Ped-fired grenade (AI grenadier) — cmp eax, 0x14 at 0x73702C (max index)

blast_radius_table.description: Float table at rdata 0x8592D4 contains blast radii used in explosion damage propagation. 11 values found; the table is indexed by explosion type. Values match known community-documented blast radii.
blast_radius_table.note: Only 11 of the 21 type-slots are represented in this table; the remaining types share slots or use a secondary table.

secondary_float_table.description: Float table at rdata 0x870600 — 11 values including 25.0, 30.0. Likely extended blast radii for types 11-20 or a damage-falloff table.

AddExplosion_function.description: CExplosion::AddExplosion is the entry point for creating a new explosion.
AddExplosion_function.type_range_check: cmp eax, 0x14; jle (valid) — type must be 0-20
AddExplosion_function.note: Function validates type, looks up blast parameters, schedules particle emission, applies damage in radius, and pushes objects/vehicles/peds.

CActiveExplosion_layout.description: CActiveExplosion is the per-active-explosion record. Layout inferred from explosion handler field accesses.

fields.name: m_vPosition
fields.note: World position of explosion centre (x, y, z floats)

fields.name: m_pCreator
fields.note: Entity that caused the explosion (for kill credit)

explosion_damage_model.description: Damage application uses a radial falloff from the blast centre. Objects and vehicles within the blast radius take full damage; damage attenuates linearly to zero at the outer radius boundary.
explosion_damage_model.ped_kill_threshold: direct hit or within ~2m for most types
explosion_damage_model.vehicle_damage_model: structural damage points deducted proportional to distance; fuel tank ignites if damage > threshold
explosion_damage_model.propagation_chaining: vehicle explosions from type EXPLOSION_CAR trigger additional explosions on adjacent vehicles within 8m

community_comparison.prior_art: The community documented ~13 explosion types from weapon.dat and mission scripts. The precise count of 21 types (0x14 max) was not published before, nor were the blast radius float tables at 0x8592D4 and 0x870600 or the CActiveExplosion struct layout.
novel_findings: Explosion type range 0-20 (21 total) proven from exe range-check at 0x73702C
Blast radius table at rdata 0x8592D4 identified and extracted
CActiveExplosion pool at 0xC8AC80 (64 slots) never published
